vignette: A child with a known systemic condition has periodontal disease on examination. The dentist has determined that conservative periodontal treatment would not be gravely dangerous for this child.
stem: Which approach to this child's care is most appropriate?

options.text: Contact the child's physician about the condition and coordinate systemic and periodontal care
Manage the periodontal disease independently, without contacting the physician
Focus on in-office care only, because home care adds little for patients with systemic conditions
Use one standard preventive regimen for all such patients, without tailoring it to the individual
